name: Zaria
description: Zaria was a terrestrial world located in the Zaria system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Anstares and Malador systems.
lead_paragraphs: Zaria was a terrestrial world located in the Zaria system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Anstares and Malador systems.

An industrial world, Zaria was the homeworld of the sentient, frog-like Zarian species. Although the Zarians themselves were free, their homeworld, like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, was under the control of the region's aristocratic Ancient Houses.
